ja499:1.1: Dūre apassan thero va cakkhuṃ yācitum āgato, ekanettā bhavissāma, cakkhum me dehi yācito to.
ja499:2.1: Kenānusiṭṭho idha-m-āgato si vanibbaka cakkhupathāni yācituṃ, suduccajaṃ yācasi uttamaṅgaṃ yam āhu nettaṃ purisena duccajan ti.
ja499:3.1: Yaṃ āhu devesu Sujampatīti Maghavā ti naṃ āhu manussaloke, tenānūsiṭṭho idha-m-āgato 'smi vanibbako cakkhupathāni yācituṃ.
ja499:4.1: Vanibbako mayha vaṇiṃ anuttaraṃ: dadāhi me cakkhupathāni yācito, dadāhi me cakkhupathaṃ anuttaraṃ yam āhu nettaṃ purisena duccayaṃ.
ja499:5.1: Yena atthena āgañchi yam attham abhipatthayaṃ te te ijjhantu saṃkappā: labha cakkhūni brāhmaṇa.
ja499:6.1: Ekan te yācamānassa ubhayāni dadām' ahaṃ, sa cakkhumā gaccha janassa pekkhato, yad icchase tvaṃ tan te samijjhatū 'ti.
ja499:7.1: Mā no deva adā cakkhuṃ, mā no sabbe parākari, dhanaṃ dehi mahārāja muttā veḷuriyā bahū.
ja499:8.1: Yutte deva rathe dehi ājānīye c' alaṃkate, nāge dehi mahārāja hemakappanavāsase.
ja499:9.1: Yathā taṃ Sivayo sabbe sayoggā sarathā sadā samantā parikareyyuṃ evaṃ dehi rathesabhā 'ti.
ja499:10.1: Yo ve dassan ti vatvāna adāne kurute mano bhumyā so patitaṃ pāsaṃ gīvāya paṭimuñcati.
ja499:11.1: Yo ve dassan ti vatvāna adāne kurute mano pāpā pāpataro hoti sampatto Yamasādanaṃ.
ja499:12.1: Yaṃ hi yāce taṃ hi dade, yaṃ na yāce na taṃ dade, sv-āhaṃ tam eva dassāmi yaṃ maṃ yācati brāhmaṇo ti.
ja499:13.1: Āyun nu vaṇṇan nu sukhaṃ balan nu kiṃ patthayāno nu janinda desi, kathaṃ hi rājā Sivinaṃ anuttaro cakkhūni dajjā parolokahetū 'ti gātham āhaṃsu.
ja499:14.1: Na v' āham etaṃ yasasā dadāmi, na puttam icche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, satañ ca dhammo carito purāṇo, icc-eva dāne ramate mano maman ti.
ja499:15.1: Sakhā ca mitto ca mamāsi Sīvaka susikkhito, sādhukarohi me vaco, laddhatvañ cakkhūni mamaṃ jigiṃsato hatthesu ṭhapehi vanibbakassā 'ti.
ja499:16.1: Codito Sivirājena Sivako vacanaṃkaro rañño cakkhūni uddhatvā brāhmaṇass' upanāmaye, sacakkhu brāhmaṇo āsi, andho rājā upāvisīti.
ja499:17.1: Tato so katipāhassa uparūḷhesu cakkhusu sūtaṃ āmantayi rājā Sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaddhano:
ja499:18.1: Yojehi sārathi yānaṃ, yuttañ ca paṭivedaya, uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma pokkharaññe vanāni ca.
ja499:19.1: So ca pokkharaṇiyā tīre pallaṃkena upāvisi, tassa Sakko pātur ahu devarājā Sujampatīti
ja499:20.1: Sakko 'ham asmi devindo, āgato 'smi tav' antike, varaṃ varassu rājīsi yaṃ kiñci manas' icchasūti
ja499:21.1: Pahūtam me dhanaṃ Sakka balaṃ koso c' anappako, andhassa me sato dāni maraṇaṃ ñeva ruccatīti.
ja499:22.1: Yāni saccāni dipadinda tāni bhāsassu khattiya, saccan te bhaṇamānassa puna cakkhuṃ bhavissatīti āha.
ja499:23.1: Ye maṃ yācitum āyanti nānāgottā vanibbakā yo pi maṃ yācate tattha so pi me manaso piyo, etena saccavajjena cakkhuṃ me upapajjathā 'ti
ja499:24.1: Yaṃ maṃ so yācituṃ āgā dehi cakkhun ti brāhmaṇo tassa cakkhūni pādāsiṃ brāhmaṇassa vanibbino.
ja499:25.1: Bhiyyo maṃ āvisi pīti somanassañ c' anappakaṃ, etena saccavajjena dutiyaṃ me upapajjathā 'ti
ja499:26.1: Dhammena bhāsitā gāthā Sivīnaṃ raṭṭhavaddhana, etāni tava nettāni dibbāni paṭidiyyare.
ja499:27.1: Tirokuḍḍaṃ tiroselaṃ samatiggayha pabbataṃ samantā yojanasataṃ dassanaṃ anubhontu te ti
ja499:28.1: Ko n' īdha vittaṃ na dadeyya yācito api visiṭṭhaṃ supiyam pi attano. tad iṃgha sabbe Sivayo samāgatā dibbāni nettāni mam' ajja passatha.
ja499:29.1: Tirokuḍḍaṃ tiroselaṃ samatiggayha pabbataṃ samantā yojanasataṃ dassanaṃ anubhonti me.
ja499:30.1: Na cāgamattā param atthi kiñci maccānaṃ idha jīvite, datvāna mānusaṃ cakkhuṃ laddham [me] cakkhuṃ amānusaṃ.
ja499:31.1: Etam pi disvā Sivayo detha dānāni bhuñjatha, datvā ca bhutvā ca yathānubhāvaṃ aninditā saggam upetha ṭhānan ti.
